The Central Luzon State University Distance, Open, and Transnational University (CLSU DOT-Uni) provides equitable access to higher education through an alternative, non-residential, and ICT-mediated teaching-learning delivery system. It offers various programs including doctoral, master's, diploma, and certificate courses. For more information, visit our official website: CLSU DOT-Uni.

The Central Luzon State University (CLSU) began as the Central Luzon Agricultural School (CLAS) on April 12, 1907, focusing on agriculture and mechanics arts. It became the Central Luzon Agricultural College (CLAC) in 1954 and was elevated to university status as CLSU in 1964. The CLSU Open University was established on August 29, 1997, and later renamed CLSU Distance, Open, and Transnational University (CLSU DOT-Uni) on February 15, 2018, to expand its reach in providing quality education through distance and transnational modalities.
To apply for admission, please visit our Admission Application Page and follow the outlined steps. For inquiries, you can email us at dot-uni@dotclsu.edu.ph.

CLSU DOT-Uni offers a range of programs including doctoral, master's, diploma, and certificate courses. You can explore the full list on our Programs Offered page.
